notes.title: 【2.6.0】Update
notes.notes:
- Allows to obtain and equip duplicate curses
- Deleted the curses [Sunflower], [Adrenaline], [Eagle Claw], [Serum], [Horned Hat], [Mare Milk], [Poison Wine]
- Added the curses [Dragon Scale], [Critical Hit Potion], [Dragon Palm], [Thirsty Blood Sword], [Poison Vine], [Arrogance Potion], [Bone Crown]
- Reworked the curses [Dagger], [Silver Armor]
- Reworked the cards [Full Force Attack], [Triple Dart]
- Added blessings [Poison Wine], [Serum], [Maple Leaf], [Vine], [Prickly Rose]

### Balance Adjustment
- Significantly weakened monsters at levels 1-3
- Progressively strengthened monsters at levels 4-12
- Removed the attack limit of the curse [Knife]
- Removed the restriction that the curse [Snail Shell] takes effect only when there is no armor
- Removed the attack reduction setting of the curse [White Fox Mask]
- The curses [Critical Hit Ring] and [Devouring] no longer have a growth limit
- Reduced the damage of the card [Thousand-pound Hammer] by 2 points
- Card [Whirling Strike] damage increased to 4, energy consumption increased to 2
- Card [Book of Armor] [Firefly] add passive effect
- Card [Random Throw] add multiple enhancement effect
- Card [Blood Sacrifice Blade] adjusts the number of attacks from increasing the number of attacks per layer of revenge to every 2 layers
- Card [Critical Dagger] critical strike reduced to 30%
- Card [Poison Explosion] reduce energy consumption a little, and the enhancement effect is changed to poison damage
- Blessing [Spinning Smash] critical strike bonus reduced to 150%

notes.title: hotfix-2.5.1
notes.notes:
- Fixed the issue where the game could not be cleared after rotation 6
- Fixed the issue where the game crashed due to random events
- Blessing [Explosive Hammer] critical hit bonus adjusted to 30%
- Blessing [Dagger Amplification] critical hit bonus adjusted to 20%
- Card [Rage] critical hit bonus adjusted to 5%

notes.title: 2.5.0 Update
notes.notes:
Major Update
- Reworked all monster mechanics. Values, art
- Reworked the level selection scene. Now you can see the specific monsters and health at the level selection. You can also choose different resource allocation routes as needed. - Added direct jumps between floors in level selection
- Added new levels, from level 7 to level 11
- Reworked scenes, GUI art

Bug Fixes
- Fixed the problem that [Knife Cutting] cannot be stacked
- Fixed the problem that shield counter can be triggered even when there is no armor and strength

notes.title: 【hotfix】2.4.3
notes.notes:
### Bug fixes & optimizations
- Added version detection to fix the crash when continuing the game save
- Fixed the problem that [Heavenly Punishment] could not trigger the effect when adding multiple attacks
- Fixed the problem that the store kept refreshing
- Fixed the problem that the gold coins were displayed incorrectly when purchasing the card [Nourishment]
- Fixed the problem that the blessing [Corruption Potion] did not cause health to be deducted in the question mark room

notes.title: 2.5.0 update
notes.notes:
### Gameplay Update
- Deleted cards [Bloodthirst Strike], [Frenzy], [Blood Pool], [Blood Explosion], [Blood Dagger], [Revenge Strike], [Blood Shield], [Blood Rain]
- Added cards [Bloodthirst Blade], [Blood Sacrifice Blade], [Poison Blood], [Nourishment], [Blood Waterfall], [Blood Rage], [Blood Guardian], [Blood Judgment]
- Adjusted the card effects of [Blood Bottle] and [Blood Barrier]
- Blessings [Bloodthirst Strike Amplification] and [Ultimate Frenzy] effects adjusted and renamed [Bloodthirst Amplification] and [Ultimate Blood Sacrifice]

### Balance Adjustment
- Card [Strength] energy consumption reduced to 1
- Curse Seal [Bana] gains armor enhancement to 4/5/6/7 when injured
- Curse Seal [Hidden Blade] gains damage bonus to 2/3/4/5 when injured
- Curse Seal [Voodoo Doll] gains critical hit muscle enhancement to 7%/8%/9%/10% when injured

notes.title: 【hotfix】2.4.2
notes.notes:
### Gameplay Update
- Added cards [Meditation] and [Enlightenment]
- Added curse [Torch]
- Deleted curse [Healing Orb]
- Added blessings [Strong Liquor], [Corruption Potion], [Honeycomb], [Snake Seedling]

### Balance Adjustment
- Weakened the curse [Roasted Meatballs], and reduced the armor bonus from 2/3/4/5 to 1/2/3/4
- Weakened the card [Fang Shield]. The damage caused is reduced from 100% of the armor value to 50%
- Reduced the strength of 1st and 2nd layer [Elite]
- Significantly reduced the strength of [Artifact Guardian]
- Increased the number of acquisitions of 1st and 2nd layer [Cards] in the level
- The cost of the card [Spike Defense] is reduced from 2 to 1
- The rarity of the blessing [Dress Up] is adjusted to rare

### Bug fixes
- Fixed the problem that [Shield Slam] adds armor in some cases
- Fixed the problem that [Secret Room] caused a black screen when clicking quickly
- Fixed the problem that the game crashed when clicking Finish after strengthening the card
- Fixed the display problem when the store refreshed
- Fixed the problem that weapons obtained in the question mark room can be stacked

notes.title: 【hotfix】2.4.1
notes.notes:
- Fixed the problem that the stone gate cannot be exited
- Fixed the problem that the resources on the void gate cannot be obtained
- Fixed the problem of obtaining duplicate curses in the question mark room
- Fixed the problem that the rewards in the question mark room do not match
- Fixed the problem that the first card cannot be selected when cleaning
- Fixed the problem that gold coins can be negative
- Fixed the problem that the critical hit rate enhancement becomes weak

notes.title: 【 hotfix 】2.3.2
notes.notes:
-Fixed the problem of pointer getting stuck when playing cards
- Add error detection

notes.title: 【hotfix】2.3.1
notes.notes:
### Bug fixes
- Fixed screen adaptation issues
- Fixed the abnormal display problem of critical hit rate
- Adjust some text descriptions

notes.title: 1.4.0 update
notes.notes:
Gameplay update
- Added new level event [Card], you can directly obtain the assembled card
- The player's initial cards are adjusted to 4, 2 [Attack], 2 [Block]
- Removed the level event [Curse Seal] [Engraving] [Store] from the first level and added [Card]
- The second layer increases [cards] and reduces the number of [cursed seals]
- The negative effects of the relic [Poisonous Wine] are removed

Optimization & bug fixing
- Add some mechanism descriptions and operational feedback
- Fixed the issue where [Frenzy] does not take effect when [Fixed] is paired with [Frenzy]

notes.title: 1.3.4 Update
notes.notes:
Gameplay update
- Adjusted level events at different levels to make level events more abundant and reasonable
- The negative effect of the relic [Blood Eye Knife] is adjusted to lose the blood volume of the current attack.
- The relic [Poison Wine] adds a negative effect. When triggered, the player adds a layer of poison to the player.
- The negative effects of [White Fox Mask] [Horn Hat] and [Adrenaline] will also be strengthened with forging.

Balance adjustments
- A large number of adjustments to the value of curse seals (too many to list one by one), weakening the basic attack, energy consumption, etc. of advanced curse seals
- Adjust the explosion rate of the curse seal from 2 out of 4 to 1 out of 3.
- The number of relic forgings reduced from 5 to 3
- Adjust the forging growth value of all relics. The higher the forging level, the greater the bonus.

Bug fixes and optimizations
- [Copy] cards can no longer copy cards with [Copy]
- Fixed the issue where [Swallow] still causes damage at the end of the turn when the monster dies.

notes.title: 1.3.2 Update
notes.notes:
Gameplay update
- Newly added relic [Poisonous Wine]
- New relic [Healing Orb]
- Newly added curse seal [negative attack]
- Added background music switch setting

Balance adjustments
- Adjustment of monster strength on levels 4-6
- Relic [Swallow], the blood volume increase is reduced from 2% to 1%
- The power increase of the relic [Lantern] is reduced from 2 to 1
- The negative effect of the relic [Eagle Claw] is changed from obtaining [Desecration] to obtaining [Binding]
- The price of the attribute [Extra Number of Attacks] increased from 4,000 gold coins to 10,000 gold coins
- The relic [Short Knife] only takes effect on damage greater than 0

Bug fixes
- Fixed the issue where monsters killed by shield counter-attack will still enter the player's negative state for settlement.
-Fixed the problem that the relic enhancement value was not initialized

notes.title: 1.3.0 Update
notes.notes:
Gameplay update
- Open levels 4 to 6
- Added level event [Relic Forging]
- Added level events [attribute enhancement]
- Added level event [Card library cleaning]
- Added new relic [Swallow]

Balance adjustments
- The initial number of shield counter-layers of the relic [Turtle Shell] is changed to 15
- The initial effect of the relic [serum] is changed to poison damage reduction
- The negative effect of the relic [Little Daisy] has been adjusted, and the card [Desecration] will be obtained instead.
- The damage bonus algorithm of the weapon [Golden Sword] has been adjusted to weaken the later ability. The bonus value is displayed directly next to the weapon.
- The energy consumption of [Bleeding-Ⅲ] is adjusted from -5 to -4
- The energy consumption of [Attack-Ⅴ] is increased to 6
- The number of attacks of [Extra Attack-V] is adjusted from 7 to 6
- Blessing [Compounding Profits] has been adjusted to the third level of blessing

Bug fixes and optimizations
- Fixed the problem of incorrect energy consumption when using other skill cards after using [Energy Accumulation]
-Fixed the problem of decimals appearing in monster health bar
- Adjust the protagonist's image
-Added death animation for the protagonist
- Some art resources updated

notes.title: 1.2.8 update
notes.notes:
Balance adjustments
- [Shuriken] energy consumption increased by 1
- [Knife cutting meat] energy consumption increased by 2
- [Blessing] Energy consumption increased by 1
- [Blessing-Ⅱ] Energy consumption increased by 2
- [Consumption] Energy consumption reduced by 1, now -4
- [Sacrifice] Energy consumption reduced by 1, now -5
- [Blood Loss-Ⅲ] Energy consumption changed to -3

Bug fixes
- Fixed the issue where monsters would still cause damage when they die during multiple attacks.
-Fixed the issue of card drawing being stuck when there are no cards in the draw pile and discard pile.
- Fixed the issue where [Copy] can exceed the upper limit of hand cards
- Fixed the problem of incorrect energy consumption calculation when using [Copy] and [Start] together.

optimization
- Updated some art resources and optimized intention icons and cards
- Added selected status to cards being engraved
- Solve the problem of monster loading lag in battle scenes
- Optimized the arrangement of ability-type curse seals
